farey-sequences-stern-7a1f.falsifies: The Stern-Brocot tree does not constrain the valid-m set beyond what the gcd-threshold already captures.
farey-sequences-stern-7a1f.need: Farey sequences / Stern-Brocot mediant structure as a tool for bounding or enumerating rational ratios — how the mediant property restricts which fractions can appear as solutions to ratio-equality constraints.
farey-sequences-stern-7a1f.why: To determine whether the set of 35 valid m has a mediant-closure property (closed under taking mediants of consecutive elements) that could reduce candidate enumeration or expose a generating procedure.
